description: Sorts the files sitting directly in a folder into its subfolders, making a subfolder when two or more belong together; with `folderId: null`, files loose at the top go into the best folder anywhere. The same reading that files uploads on arrival: it runs in the background, and Home shows what moved, why, and an undo for each. Reads up to 60 files a call. Use it when someone asks to tidy or organize a folder; to put specific things somewhere, use workspace_folders_file. May return needs_confirmation.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

folderId.description: The folder to sort; null sorts what's loose at the top.

workspace.description: Workspace slug, for tokens without a default.

name: workspace_files_sort
title: Sort a folder's files
